_note: DQ-T55 live arm — the author's own notes are in the message, so a fabricated source is never necessary.

scenarios.prompt: Here are my notes: Aldric Vane is a warden of Hollow Keep, and Mira Solene runs the archive there. Add everything in here to my glossary.
scenarios.prompt_source: DQ-T55. The author supplies their OWN notes in the message, which is exactly the case source_ref='last_user_message' exists to serve: the server can fetch what they wrote, so the model never needs to compose a document.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the tool is called with a source_markdown the SERVER did not resolve — i.e. text that is not the author's own message. The recorded failure shape is a wholly invented document ('Wei Wuxian', 'Azure Cloud Sect', 'Aethelgard', 'Elara'), which appears nowhere in this prompt; any of those names in the dispatched args refutes it. A refusal naming source_ref is NOT a failure — it is the contract working.

answer_expect.why: The candidates must come from the AUTHOR'S notes, which name Aldric Vane and Mira Solene.

ship_audit.gate: n/a — Tier R, derives candidates and writes nothing.
ship_audit.absent_case: an empty author message resolves to an empty document — refused by the far side.
